title: ICPC.GAY
subtitle: Code. Compete. Create.
description: A place for programmers, problem solvers, and everyone who enjoys competitive programming.
what_gay_desc: A place made by programmers, for programmers.
fun: Because programmers are allowed to have fun too.
fun_claim: ICPC.GAY isn't affiliated with ICPC. The name is simply a playful way of saying that we're a bunch of people who are way too passionate about competitive programming.
believe: Code is more than solving problems.
believe_claim:
· It's about curiosity.
 · It's about making things.
 · It's about learning from failure.
 · It's about staying up late because you really want to know why it works.

Competitive programming is only part of the story.
who_for_claim:
For the beginner who just wrote their first program.

For the contestant preparing for their next ICPC.

For the programmer who enjoys building weird things.

For anyone who thinks programming is fun.
